truth_evidence: Affected every release before 3.1.6; fixed in 3.1.6 (the attr filter used plain getattr, so |attr('format') reached an unsandboxed str.format).
Fix commit 90457bb 'Merge commit from fork / attr filter uses env.getattr', in tag 3.1.6 and not in 3.1.5. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/90457bbf33b8662926ae65cdde4c4c32e756e403
do_attr: the getattr + is_safe_attribute body is replaced by getattr_static probing followed by environment.getattr(obj, name), which applies the sandbox.

This function is a template filter. Templates reach it through the filter table (jinja2.filters.FILTERS), not through a Python call, so a project that uses the filter in a template has no Python call to it. Python-level call analysis cannot see template usage; the scan side must not report not_found on the strength of Python calls alone for filter advisories.
The exposure is in sandboxed environments (the filter is harmless where there is no sandbox to escape).
